name: Bob Latta
stance: Backs federal coordination on AI-discovered software vulnerabilities and the administration's June 2026 executive order on advanced AI and security.

statements.text: Led a bipartisan letter with Rep. Doris Matsui urging National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross to convene a federal-industry plan for handling AI-discovered software vulnerabilities.
Last month, Rep. @DorisMatsui and I led a bipartisan letter on AI-discovered vulnerabilities, trusted defenders, and critical infrastructure. Today’s EO on advanced AI reflects those priorities.
